math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}x<0\Rightarrow -x>0\\f(-x)=(-x)^{2}+(-x)=x^{2} - x\\f(x)=-f(-x)=-\left(x^{2} - x\right)=- x^{2} + x\\x<0\text{ 时，}f(x)=- x^{2} + x\end{gathered}$$
